data.body: [P1] Prevent stale registry reads from downgrading latest. If `latest` already points to v2.0.0, a queued v1.2.3 recovery receiving a transient `ImageNotFoundException` clears this guard and overwrites it with v1.2.3. A stale successful lookup of v1.2.2 has the same effect. Verification accepts the downgrade because it only requires `latest >= VERSION`; workflow serialization does not establish read freshness. Persist a monotonic highest-promoted stable version in strongly consistent storage under the release lock, and consult it during promotion and verification. Add backport tests for transient missing-tag responses and stale successful reads.
